title: Release plain-english-styles: cut only if content is ahead of its latest tag
description: Filed under the 2026-10-28 operator-approved plan (DEC-232). NOT STARTED and NOT dispatched: do not cut anything from this task until the leader dispatches it. MEASURED 2026-10-28 through bare gh api reads: tag v0.2.0 is an annotated object fe3dcee85f35e50b0bdb108d3b40c2c1e44fa0ea that peels to 2a06e85f3a412e524167568d7a5bd218bd097c4c. origin dev is exactly one commit ahead of that tag (d1c4683f, PES-12 close-out) and that commit touches only .quest records, so nothing in the shipped plugin or skills is unreleased beyond v0.2.0. This repository already pins v0.2.0 (OMARK-100). The only open work there that would change shipped content is COS-32 and COS-33, both To Do and unbuilt when sampled (nine of the thirty-two task files were read for status, not all). So a release may not be needed yet. Earlier plan text of 14 commits ahead came from the title of the Done task PES-12, not a commit count: all 14 are already inside v0.2.0.

acceptanceCriteria.text: at pickup the content ahead of the latest tag is re-measured and recorded on this task
if no plugin or skill content is ahead of the latest tag the task closes with that finding and no tag is cut
if a cut is warranted it is made by the repository own release path under a separate leader dispatch, and the pin and its federated-pin baseline here move together in one change
